CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

3. Best practice when working on Rugby: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rugby.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rugby.
   C. Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rugby.

4. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

5. Best practice when working on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

7. Best practice when working on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal: (1 mark)

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Basketball and Logo Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

2. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Practise Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — The speed of the music

7. C — Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Red, blue, and yellow

12. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
